title: Session data: yes, we duplicate your prompts, mostly outside git

owner_note.text: Yes. Your prompts exist word for word in the SDK session files, and we copy them in four places: owner-prompts.jsonl (6.4 MB in git), the council's words.jsonl (1.7 MB in git), every session card's Prompt item (180 MB on disk, ignored by git) and .claude/prompts (5.6 MB, ignored). About 8 MB in git and 185 MB locally. Briefs (requirements.md) are records and stay. Changed: words.jsonl and public/ai/v-*.jsonl are now ignored; council.mjs and crawl.mjs write into the sessions store instead of the retired day folder, and the two stray folders moved there by script with a manifest. Not changed (your call, exact edits are in the doc): prompt-relay.mjs:248 and council collect should store a link to the SDK file instead of the text, and the 7 tracked copies need a scripted git rm --cached. Read: /framework/ai/sessions/doc/data-sources.md
